top_choice_rationale: P001 (Buchwald and Hartwig, general Pd-catalysed C-N cross-coupling) is the only proposal where maturity, exact attribution and mechanistic evidence are all settled: four decades of independent confirmation, a mechanism examined through characterised intermediates, and ligand design that made a narrow reaction routine. The 2010 cross-coupling overlap is real but answered by the distinct amine-poisoning, beta-hydride and C-N reductive-elimination problems. P002 (degraders) is second as the larger conceptual step, held back by the PROTAC versus glue credit cut, uneven structural evidence and no approved degrader. P004 and P003 follow with open questions on priority and the 2024 prize, and on in-cell relevance respectively; all four are preferred to no award.
